description: This file implements a logging system in C++, including classes for managing log files, formatting log messages, and controlling log levels and output destinations. It also includes functions for environment variable configuration and severity level conversions.

classes.name: LogFile
classes.description: Manages log file creation, writing, and closing, ensuring thread-safe access to the log file.

classes.name: Flusher
classes.description: Handles the formatting and output of log messages, including timestamping and severity tagging.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Provides an interface for creating log messages with different severity levels.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Determines the current log level based on the RIALTO_DEBUG environment variable.

methods.name: isConsoleLogEnabled
methods.description: Checks if console logging is enabled via the RIALTO_CONSOLE_LOG environment variable.

methods.name: getRialtoLogPath
methods.description: Retrieves the log file path from the RIALTO_LOG_PATH environment variable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a Severity enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: convertSeverity
methods.description: Converts a Severity enum value to the corresponding syslog severity code.

methods.name: LogFile::instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the LogFile class.

methods.name: LogFile::write
methods.description: Writes a line to the log file.

methods.name: LogFile::isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the log file is open and writable.

methods.name: LogFile::reset
methods.description: Resets the log file by closing and reopening it.

methods.name: LogFile::tryOpenFile
methods.description: Attempts to open the log file based on environment variable configuration.

methods.name: LogFile::tryCloseFile
methods.description: Closes the log file if it is open.

methods.name: Flusher::Flusher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the log message with timestamp, component name, and severity.

methods.name: Flusher::~Flusher
methods.description: Destructor that outputs the log message to the appropriate destination based on current log level and configuration.

methods.name: Logger::Logger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a logger with a component name.

methods.name: Logger::operator<<
methods.description: Creates a Flusher object for logging with a specified severity.
